verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own marketing lists a few multi-device capabilities: MSI mass deployment, remote script execution, and automated remediation across endpoints. These suggest some ability to act on many devices at once, but nothing documents a general bulk-operation feature (multi-select actions, batch API calls, bulk edits of devices or users). Missing for 10: documented general-purpose bulk actions across many items, bulk or batch API endpoints, details on scope and limits of multi-endpoint script or remediation runs, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
